anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The candidate paper title and abstract explicitly describe the curation and release of the P300-based BCI dataset, matching the content of nm000326.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 32 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency filtering. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task using a 6x6 checkerboard stimulus paradigm with online feedback in a laboratory setting. The experimental protocol included target and non-target visual stimuli with an inter-stimulus interval of 0-1.0 seconds.
